title: Superset Alert and Report Delivery Failures
dataSources: Superset logs (`superset:app`), Metabase logs (`metabase:app`), Redash logs (`redash:app`), and embed client events (`bi:embed:client`).
app: Superset/Metabase/Redash application and Celery worker logs via Universal Forwarder; application REST APIs and embed-SDK client telemetry via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=superset:app logger="superset.tasks.scheduler" ("alert" OR "report") ("error" OR "failed")
| rex "(alert|report) '(?<schedule>[^']+)'"
| stats count as failures by schedule
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Detects Apache Superset scheduled alert and report delivery failures raised by the Celery beat scheduler, which otherwise fail without notifying recipients.
value: Superset alerts and reports are the platform's proactive layer; catching delivery failures keeps automated notifications reliable.
implementation: Ingest Superset scheduler logs; schedule hourly and alert on repeated failures per schedule. Verify the Celery worker and SMTP config on spikes.
visualization: Table of schedule by failures, timechart.
grandmaExplanation: We check that Superset's scheduled emails and alerts go out so people are not left without the update they expected.
